answer: Every agent identity locks a bond before it can transact, so a sybil attacker must fund each clone with real capital. Detection of clones triggers slashing, which seizes the entire deposit and redistributes it to honest participants. The cost of manufacturing identities thus scales with the number of clones, not the number of keys. Like a gale stripping weak branches, slashing clears the horizon of fake accounts before they harvest the nectar of shared rewards.
